defmodule App.Greeter do
  @moduledoc "Greets."

  # Greet a name.
  def greet(name, opts \\ []) when is_binary(name) do
    times = Keyword.get(opts, :times, 2)
    IO.puts("hi #{name} #{times}")
    {:ok, nil}
  end
end

module Nat where

-- Natural numbers.
data Nat : Set where
  zero : Nat
  suc  : Nat -> Nat

_+_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero  + m = m
suc n + m = suc (n + m)
